methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Drones & Autonomous (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 7 same-sector peers exist in Drones & Autonomous, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Airship Industries is a pre-seed stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector. The broader sector contains eight private peers, including established players such as Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro. No public comparables exist in this narrow segment, and the private comp universe lacks sufficient depth at pre-seed stage to support traditional peer-median valuation methods.

The peer-median approach is not applicable to this analysis. The sector contains seven same-sector peers, but filtering for companies at identical or adjacent development stages, or within comparable valuation tiers, yielded fewer than three datapoints—the minimum threshold required for meaningful statistical triangulation. Relying on all-sector median multiples would introduce unacceptable selection bias, given the substantial spread in maturity, capital intensity, and commercialization timelines across the Drones & Autonomous universe.

Without sufficient same-stage or same-tier private comparables and absent public market benchmarks, this analysis cannot generate a defensible valuation range through traditional equity-value triangulation methods. Airship Industries' pre-seed valuation would require alternative approaches—including comparable transaction multiples (if available), discounted cash flow modeling with explicit stage-based risk adjustment, or standard pre-seed stage metrics (e.g., price per fully-diluted share from equivalent recent rounds). The extreme stage mismatch between Airship and the median maturity of available peers represents a material analytical constraint that precludes confident range estimation.
